redeem.title: How to redeem codes
redeem.heading: How to redeem {game} codes
redeem.step3: Log in with your game account.
redeem.step4: Select your server and character, then paste the code.
redeem.step5: Collect the rewards from in-game mail.
redeem.inGameOnly: This game has no official web redemption page. Codes are redeemed inside the game.
redeem.noWebYet: This game has no official web redemption page yet. Check the official site for updates, or redeem in-game if that option appears.

honkai-impact-3rd: Open Honkai Impact 3rd and log in.
Tap your name in the top-left corner of the Bridge.
Open Account and find Exchange Rewards.
Paste the code and tap Get.
wuthering-waves: Reach Union Level 2, then open the Terminal menu.
Tap Redeem next to Redemption Code.
Paste the code and collect rewards from the mailbox.
nikke: Clear campaign stage 1-4, then open the Lobby.
Paste the code and collect rewards from the mailbox.
arknights: Open the menu and look for Gift Exchange or similar.
Paste the code if the option is available.
love-and-deepspace: Open Love and Deepspace and log in.
Tap your profile in the top-left corner.
Paste the code and collect rewards from the mailbox.
afk-journey: Open AFK Journey and tap your avatar.

inGame.genshin-impact: Paimon Menu → Settings → Account → Redeem Code.
inGame.honkai-star-rail: Phone menu → Redeem Code. On iOS, use the website.
inGame.zenless-zone-zero: Menu → More → Redemption Code. Unlocks after the prologue.
inGame.tears-of-themis: Rewards arrive in your in-game mailbox after a successful web redemption.
inGame.wuthering-waves: Terminal → Settings → Other Settings → Redemption Code. Unlocks at Union Level 2.
inGame.nikke: Lobby → Notice → CD-Key Redemption Portal. Unlocks after stage 1-4.
inGame.fate-grand-order: Use the official serial code page, or look in the in-game menu for Serial Code.
inGame.pokemon-tcg-pocket: Enter your Support ID on the official gift page, then paste the gift code.
inGame.arknights: Look in the in-game menu for Gift Exchange if a code is published.

about.title: About
about.p1: One place for gacha promo codes without ads, clutter and endless scrolling.
about.p2: Pick a game, copy a code, leave. That is the whole product.
about.p3: Codes are aggregated from public sources. We do not check whether a code still works — we only record when it was found.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.p1: This website is an independent fan-made project and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the game publishers.
disclaimer.p2: Promo codes are collected from publicly available sources. We do not guarantee that every listed code is currently valid.
disclaimer.p3: Always redeem codes on the official website or inside the game. Do not enter your password on unofficial pages.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: This site does not run ads, analytics pixels, or user accounts.
privacy.p2: Search and copy run in your browser. We do not collect personal data to show promo codes.
